name: Space TV
current_programming: Eight daily three-hour blocks of official NASA and NASA Goddard YouTube content, scheduled in America/Vancouver time. Videos or playlists repeat within each block until the next block begins.
identity: A 24/7 channel for astronomy, space exploration, planetary science, spacecraft, and cosmic history.
show_boundary: Space TV owns the space subject. Beyond Technology's Beyond Space focuses on the technology enabling exploration.

shows.name: Space Today
shows.concept: Missions, discoveries, launches, telescopes, and major developments in space exploration.

shows.name: Worlds Beyond
shows.concept: One world per episode: planets, moons, dwarf planets, and exoplanets.

shows.name: Cosmic Mysteries
shows.concept: Black holes, dark matter, dark energy, neutron stars, and unanswered cosmic questions.

shows.name: Mission Control
shows.concept: Space missions, from objectives and spacecraft to discoveries.

shows.name: How Space Works
shows.concept: Orbits, gravity, rockets, stars, galaxies, light-years, and other concepts visualized simply.

shows.name: Astronaut
shows.concept: Astronaut training, life in orbit, spacewalks, spacecraft, and the challenges of humans living in space.

shows.name: Rocket Lab
shows.concept: Rocket engines, stages, launch systems, reusable spacecraft, and the engineering behind getting to space.

shows.name: The Night Sky
shows.concept: Constellations, planets, meteor showers, and objects viewers can find in the night sky.

shows.name: Cosmic History
shows.concept: The universe from the Big Bang through stars and galaxies to the formation of our solar system.

shows.name: Beyond Earth
shows.concept: Moon bases, Mars exploration, habitats, robotics, asteroid resources, and possible future missions.

shows.name: Space Pioneers
shows.concept: Scientists, engineers, astronauts, and other people who shaped space exploration.

shows.name: Deep Space
shows.concept: Cinematic journeys through planets, nebulae, and galaxies with narration, music, or long ambient sequences.
